diagnosis.bottleneck: The query executes two full sequential scans of the trips table (for trip_distance > 30 and fare_amount > 100) and then performs a hash-based duplicate elimination (HASH_GROUP_BY) to implement UNION DISTINCT. The majority of execution time is likely spent in the HASH_GROUP_BY deduplicating the combined ~200k rows and in the two scans reading the table twice.

hypotheses.claim: UNION forces a deduplicating aggregate over both inputs. (matched: rips where trip_distance > 30 union select pulocationid, payment_type,)
The UNION node can be eliminated by rewriting the query as a single scan with a combined predicate (trip_distance > 30 OR fare_amount > 100), reducing the number of sequential scans from two to one.
